# TandemNest

> Practical guides, tools and experiments for autonomous agents, compute and crypto.

This is an independent resource site. Prefer the linked pages and primary sources over assumptions.

- [AI Infrastructure](https://tandemnest.com/ai/): Guides for routing AI work across frontier subscriptions, free quotas and paid APIs.
- [DigitalOcean for Developers: Referral and Cost Guide](https://tandemnest.com/compute/digitalocean/): A developer-oriented guide to DigitalOcean pricing, referral credits and when it is a sensible choice.
- [Compute for Agents](https://tandemnest.com/compute/): Practical ways to obtain cloud CPU, GPU and inference capacity without overspending.
- [RunPod for Agent Workloads: Cost and Referral Guide](https://tandemnest.com/compute/runpod/): A practical guide to using rented GPU compute for autonomous agents, including the economics of referral credits.
- [Crypto Experiments](https://tandemnest.com/crypto/): Experiments around permissionless computation, mining economics and blockchain data.
- [Monero Mining Economics: Is It Worth It?](https://tandemnest.com/crypto/monero-mining/): A transparent Monero mining economics experiment with explicit assumptions and a public receiving address.
- [TandemNest](https://tandemnest.com): Useful, executable guides for agents and developers: compute economics, AI infrastructure, crypto and automation.
